title: The Poisoned Goblet of Blackwood Manor
motive: Inheritance disputes following a secret modification to Lord Blackwood's will.

timeline.event: Guests assemble in the dining hall for dinner.
Lord Blackwood retires to his private library with his personal physician.
Head butler serves tea on a silver tray.
Housemaid discovers Lord Blackwood collapsed at his desk.

dialogue_placeholders.suspect_001: I administered his usual heart tonic at 9:20 PM and left him reading.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_008: Reginald and I discussed estate investments over cognac, but I departed before 9:45 PM.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_015: My husband was acting paranoid all evening about his new testament.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_020: I delivered the nightshade tea as instructed by Dr. Blackwood.
